name: Minamata (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Minamata city emblem in white: an outlined ring open at the top with a small hexagon, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Minamata, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1949.

features.role: Minamata city emblem — an outlined ring open at the top with a small hexagon, like a stylised character
